title: Warm-prism portable design system and whole-site adoption

acceptanceCriteria: Warm neutral palette, tokenized type/space/radius/shadows; warm lemon/peach/lilac prism only on interaction edges.
Glass only floating layers; European shared events return to ordinary surfaces.
No dark theme, responsive layout variants, or entrance/continuous decorative motion in source.
Preserve chart/data/editor semantics, user records and existing unrelated edits.
Typecheck, build, regression tests and desktop/narrow viewport verification. Production deployment explicitly requested by user on 2026-11-19.
